description:
Activate Breya by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Breya enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Breya
Resolve the Breya trigger, creating two artifact tokens
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Breya and another artifact, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
